business_summary.text: TVS Motor Company is a two and three-wheeler manufacturer globally, with manufacturing facilities in India and Indonesia, operating in 80 countries.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Directorate of Revenue Intelligence, Chennai had issued a show cause notice to the company on 28.09.2020 disputing the HSN classification of certain parts for the period from 14.10.2015 to 31.03.2020 involving a differential duty of Rs.39.26 Cr and the company had filed its reply before CoC Adjudication on 28th Jan 2021. As an update to the ongoing litigation, CoC Adjudication has passed an order on 20th May 2025 making a demand for an amount of Rs. 152.54 Cr which includes Penalty & Fine of Rs.113.27 Cr. Company has filed its appeal and the same is pending before CESTAT, Mumbai.
tax_litigation.status: During the quarter, the Company received show cause notices from Customs disputing the HSN classification of similar parts of imports made during April 2021 to Dec 2024 involving a customs duty demand of Rs. 13.67 crore. The Company has submitted its reply before the CoC, referring to the pending appeal before the CESTAT on the same grounds. The Company is also in the process of filing a petition seeking an early hearing.

tax_litigation.status: During the quarter, the following two actions were taken by the Department. 1. Obtained a six-month extension (until September 2026) to conclude the Show Cause Notice (SCN) proceedings for customs duty demand of Rs. 13.67 crore. 2. Issued a supplementary SCN for changing the classification adopted by the Department in the SCN issued earlier. As the ground for issuing supplementary SCN is outside purview of regulations, the Company has filed a Writ Petition before the Hon’ble High Court Judicature at Chennai. For the demand relates to Rs. 152.54 Cr, the hearing is pending before the CESTAT, Mumbai.

guidance.statement: Q2 industry growth to be double-digit, with TVS outperforming; EV growth momentum to continue.
Two-wheeler capacity to reach 8.3 million units by Q4FY27.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Automobiles > 2/3 Wheelers

operating_notes.text: Partnership with Hyundai Motor Company for electric three-wheeler development
Entered the Zambian market with an eight-product lineup via distributor Zamoto Manufacturing Limited.
April 2026 dispatches impacted by supply chain constraints, raw material shortages, and container availability.
Launched TVS iQube S 4.7 kWh electric scooter variant with 175 km IDC-certified range at ₹1,37,142 ex-showroom Delhi.
NCLT Chennai Bench sanctioned the amalgamation of wholly owned subsidiary Sundaram Auto Components Limited with TVS Motor Company.
Recorded highest ever annual sales of 58.89 Lakh units and revenue of ₹47,270.32 Cr in FY26.
TVS EBike agreed to transfer assets and liabilities to Callista Asset Management for an estimated CHF 16 Mn, expected to complete by August 13, 2026.
Launched TVS King EV MAX electric three-wheeler in Nepal.
Board approved acquisition of 4.9% stake in Jana Small Finance Bank for ₹1,933 Cr
FY26 total sales volume reached 5.9 million units, up 24% YoY.
Ranked #1 globally for shareholder value in durable goods by WirtschaftsWoche and BCG
May 2026 total sales of 566,585 units were the highest ever, with EV sales of 43,632 units and international business of 175,991 units also at record highs.
TVS HLX series crossed 5 million cumulative global sales across 57+ countries.
Announced TVS Paddock as an exclusive retail channel for its premium portfolio, scheduled for launch in Q2 FY27.
Q1FY27 EV revenue was about ₹1,780 Cr; export revenue was ₹3,634 Cr; spare parts revenue was ₹1,173 Cr.
PLI incentive was about 0.6-0.7% of turnover; about ₹600 Cr of PLI receivable is pending.
Dealer inventory is kept below 30 days, with a target of 25-30 days.
CARE Ratings reaffirmed TVS Motor's CARE AAA; Stable and CARE A1+ ratings across ₹4,858 Cr of total rated facilities.
Shareholders approved the appointment of Mr. Peyman Kargar as Director & CEO for 5 years effective 27th January 2027.

timeline.summary: TVS Motor signed a Joint Development Agreement with Hyundai Motor Company on 20 April 2026 for the development and commercialization of electric three-wheelers.
TVS Motor announced its official entry into the Zambian market on April 20, 2026, partnering with Zamoto Manufacturing Limited as its official distributor.
TVS Motor reported a 7% YoY increase in total sales to 473,970 units for April 2026, constrained by supply chain issues.
TVS Motor launched the TVS iQube S 4.7 kWh electric scooter variant with a 175 km range priced at ₹1,37,142.
TVS Motor announced that the NCLT Chennai Bench sanctioned the scheme of amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary Sundaram Auto Components Limited on 6th May 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹15,052.73 Cr (+30.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹771.52 Cr (+19.0% YoY).
TVS Motor board proposed appointing Mr. Ravindran Shanmugam as Non-Executive Independent Director for 5 years from 13 May 2026, subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot.
TVS Motor announced that its step-down subsidiary TVS EBike Company AG agreed to transfer certain assets and liabilities to Callista Asset Management 33 GmbH for CHF 16 million.
TVS Motor launched its TVS King EV MAX electric three-wheeler in Nepal.
2026-05-18: TVS Motor approved acquisition of 4.9% stake in Jana Small Finance Bank for ₹193.31 Cr
TVS Motor reported FY26 revenue of ₹47,270 Cr, up 30% YoY, with Q4 EBITDA margin reaching 13.1%.
2026-05-25: TVS Motor ranked #1 globally for shareholder value in durable goods by WirtschaftsWoche and BCG
2026-06-01: TVS Motor reported record May 2026 sales of 566,585 units, up 31% YoY, with EV sales up 56% to 43,632 units and international business up 49%.
TVS Motor announced that its TVS HLX series crossed 5 million in global sales across 57+ countries.
2026-06-06: TVS Motor announced the launch of TVS Paddock, a premium bespoke retail and ownership experience channel, scheduled for Q2 FY27.
2026-07-28: TVS Motor Q1FY27 revenue rose 38% YoY to ₹13,896 Cr, EBITDA margin 12.8%, PAT up 51% to ₹1,174 Cr; credit rating upgraded to CARE AAA.
2026-10-19: CARE Ratings reaffirmed TVS Motor's CARE AAA (Stable) and CARE A1+ ratings across ₹4,858 Cr of bank facilities and debt instruments.
TVS Motor announced on 22nd October 2026 that shareholders approved the appointment of Mr. Peyman Kargar as Director and CEO effective 27th January 2027.
